note: 'Metaphysics' is not a primal word (Urwort) but a late Greek-derived title (ta meta ta physika) designating philosophy; the word gets its meaning from an understanding of philosophy, not the reverse.

target: the self-forming prevailing of beings as a whole
note: physis rendered beyond 'nature'/'growth' as das Walten — a prevailing that runs through man, more originary than the nature/history split; even includes divine beings.
Latin natura/nasci (to be born, arise, grow) is the customary translation; Heidegger uses it only to launch the deeper rendering.
legein = speaking-out; logos = the prevailing that has been spoken out / become manifest.
The fundamental function of legein/logos is to take whatever prevails from concealment — revealing (Entbergen).
kryptein (Verbergen) = keeping in concealment; established as the opposite of legein from Heraclitus Frgm. 93 (the Oracle gives a sign).
legein (revealing) and kryptein (concealing) are explicit opposites; the logos wrests the prevailing from concealment.
Read via the a-privativum as a-letheia (cf. German Un-schuld, Un-endlichkeit): that which is not concealed; not the 'colourless' 'that which is true'.
physis 'has in itself a striving to conceal itself' (Heraclitus Frgm. 123, 'physis loves to hide'), so truth must be torn from it.

Truth is understood by the Greeks as something stolen, torn from concealment in a confrontation where physis strives to conceal itself; rooted in human finitude, 'nothing to do with proving propositions at the writing desk'.
Frgms. 93/123/112/54/30 supply the physis-logos-aletheia complex and the kosmos-as-ever-living-fire image.
Heidegger recalls he 'emphatically pointed to this primal meaning of the Greek concept of truth' in Being and Time — not mere etymology but exposing man's fundamental position in antiquity.
Aristotle's physiologoi are not 'physiologists'/'philosophers of nature' but the primordial title for those who question beings as a whole and bring physis to revealedness.
First meaning of physis: a regional concept, the physei onta (self-prevailing) opposed to the techne onta (the produced).
Second meaning of physis: prevailing-as-such, the inner essence/law of any matter — in Aristotle, ousia, the being of beings.
That which makes beings beings (ousia, still called physis by Aristotle) is the second object of First Philosophy.
Aristotle amalgamates the dual orientation — beings as a whole AND the being (ousia) of beings — as prote philosophia / philosophizing proper.
Aristotle 'says nothing' about how the two orientations form a unity; the question is open 'to this day' and 'is not even posed any more today'.
The theion (divine / Prime Mover) is the ultimate determinant within the physei onta, named without religious connotation; grounds the prima-philosophia/theology link.
epistasthai = to stand before a matter and know one's way around in it; only in Aristotle does episteme take the decided sense of 'science'.
physis, ethos (ethics) and the logos itself are codified as logic/physics/ethics — the decline of philosophizing proper, in which 'living questioning dies out'.
ethos = man's stance/self-conduct (distinct from physis); source of 'ethics,' one of the three scholastic themes.
Adversus Mathematicos VII.16 (ed. Bekker 1842): the logic/physics/ethics division was prefigured in Plato and founded by Xenocrates, the Peripatetics, and the Stoics.
First Philosophy fit no discipline ('embarrassment'); filed positionally 'behind physics' — a technical title saying nothing about content.
meta = after/behind/post (cf. methodos), purely positional; indicates only the order of the writings.
meta shifts via metabole (changeover, Umschlag) to over/beyond (trans): metaphysics = knowledge of the suprasensuous, conceived in terms of content.

target: the fate of philosophy proper in the West
note: Heidegger insists the post->trans changeover 'is by no means inconsequential': 'Something essential is decided by it — the fate of philosophy proper in the West'.
Three incongruities asserted: trivialized, intrinsically confused, unproblematic (never lets 'metaphysics' itself become a problem).
Trivialization (the metaphysical as a higher being merely 'at hand') is 'a complete misinterpretation of the theion which, in Aristotle, is at least left to stand as a problem'.
§13: Aquinas equates prima philosophia = metaphysica = theologia/scientia divina via the threefold maxime intelligibile (Prooemium to his Aristotle commentary).
The most-knowable (Lat.) divided threefold yields the science governing all others; most intellectual because it deals with the most knowable = most suprasensuous.
Aquinas's transphysica (unum, multa, potentia, actus) found 'in via resolutionis,' lying beyond the sensuous — his term anticipating ontology / metaphysica generalis.
Aquinas holds the three directions together 'in a way essentially determined by faith,' never oriented to the intrinsic problematic — 'covering over the problem'.
§14: Suarez (Disputationes metaphysicae, 1597) first develops the metaphysical problem independently/systematically, decisively shaping modern metaphysics and Descartes.
Suarez calls metaphysics 'metaphysica' because it is theology (deals with God), deviating from Aquinas's de ente in communi.
Descartes (La Fleche; consulted Suarez repeatedly) carries the Suarezian metaphysics into modern philosophy; Meditationes de prima philosophia targets proof of God + immortality of the soul.

target: the fate of philosophy proper in the West
note: Modern metaphysics demands absolute certainty (mathematical natural science); places the I as 'most secure and unquestioned foundation' — the questioner included only negatively.

target: metaphysics as the fundamental problem of metaphysics itself
note: 'Metaphysics' is taken over not traditionally but as the title for the question of what metaphysics itself is — inseparable from philosophy, unposable by the sciences about themselves.

source: metaphysics as the fundamental problem of metaphysics itself
note: The negative result demands action 'within metaphysics': let world/finitude/individuation arise from a fundamental attunement — 'awakening a fundamental attunement of our philosophizing'.
§15->§16 seam hands directly into Part One's awakening of profound boredom (fcm-03+), the attunement on which the King-Salvo bridge turns.
